components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default button: full width, filled accent, 44px.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #00bfc4; color: #07383a; font: 600 14px/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), transform 100ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #00bfc4 88%, #07383a); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #006f73; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: color-mix(in srgb, #00bfc4 28%, #fff); color: color-mix(in srgb, #07383a 60%, #fff); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Icon Action
components.description: 40px square action with a tooltip from its label and an attention state.
components.css: .ds-icon-action { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 1px solid rgb(23 32 44 / 19%); border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #182033; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-icon-action svg { opacity: 0.72; } .ds-icon-action:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #00bfc4 9%, #fff); } .ds-icon-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #006f73; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-icon-action[data-attention] { border-color: #d99a21; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, #d99a21 24%, transparent); } .ds-icon-action[data-attention]::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -5px; right: -5px; width: 8px; height: 8px; border: 2px solid #fff; border-radius: 50%; background: #d99a21; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: 44px field with a firm hairline; accent edge on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #667085; font: 500 12px/1.25 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid rgb(23 32 44 / 19%); border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #182033; padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 14px/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #00bfc4; outline: 2px solid #006f73; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Toggle
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 40px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 4px; color: #667085; font: 400 11px/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toggle input { appearance: none; position: relative; width: 36px; height: 20px; margin: 0; border: 1px solid rgb(23 32 44 / 19%); border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #667085 28%, #fff); transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-toggle input::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 22%); transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-toggle input:checked { border-color: #00bfc4; background: #00bfc4; } .ds-toggle input:checked::before { transform: translateX(16px); } .ds-toggle input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #006f73; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Three equal segments in one frame; the checked one fills with accent.
components.css: .ds-segments { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgb(23 32 44 / 19%); border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-segments label { position: relative; color: #667085; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segments label + label { border-left: 1px solid rgb(23 32 44 / 11%); } .ds-segments input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; } .ds-segments span { display: block; padding: 8px 4px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; text-align: center; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-segments input:checked + span { background: #00bfc4; color: #07383a; } .ds-segments input:focus-visible + span { outline: 2px solid #006f73; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Pill on accent-soft with accent-ink tabular text.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-block; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #00bfc4 12%, #fff); color: #006f73; padding: 4px 8px; font: 600 11px/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Steps
components.description: Three-step progress; the current step's rule and label take the accent.
components.css: .ds-steps { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-steps li { display: grid; gap: 4px; border-top: 3px solid rgb(23 32 44 / 11%); padding-top: 8px; color: #667085; font-size: 11px; text-align: center; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-steps li.current { border-color: #00bfc4; color: #006f73; } .ds-steps span { font-size: 10px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.description: The catalogue entry: product ground, bottom gradient, name and status with a dot.

components.css: .ds-tile { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; width: 220px; aspect-ratio: 1; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgb(23 32 44 / 11%); border-radius: 12px; background: #edf2f7; padding: 16px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-tile::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 40%, rgb(237 242 247 / 94%) 100%); } .ds-tile:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #00bfc4 45%, rgb(23 32 44 / 19%)); } .ds-tile-badge { position: absolute; z-index: 2; top: 12px; right: 12px; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid rgb(23 32 44 / 28%); border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 78%); } .ds-tile-copy { position: relative; z-index: 2; color: #17202c; } .ds-tile-copy h3 { margin: 0 0 2px; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-tile-copy p { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.25; color: color-mix(in srgb, #1a7f4b 75%, #17202c); } .ds-tile-copy i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #1a7f4b; }

narrative.overview:
The interface is a catalogue of the household's devices. On the dashboard each device is a tile, and each tile shows either a packaged product photograph, desaturated and inset on a flat ground, or the camera's own last frame filling the tile. Everything else steps back so those images carry the page: one teal accent, a neutral panel, hairline edges, and the host's system font. The UI is a guest inside Homebridge's settings page. It keeps a transparent body, follows the host's light or dark theme, and inherits `--bs-body-color` so its text levels move with the host.

Controls are tactile and confident. Every primary target is 44px tall, the primary button is filled with the accent, a press scales it to 0.97, and every state can be read without color: an attention dot beside the alert ring, a word beside the capture icon, a dot beside a status label. The sheet holds itself to written scales and treats any value off them as a defect: spacing on a 4px grid, five radius tokens, four text levels, two edge intensities, one easing curve, and one overlay shadow.

The layout is a single column of at most 720px, sized for the Homebridge settings modal. It reflows from a three-column device grid to two columns, then to a stack of 2:1 tiles on a phone.
keyCharacteristics: Device imagery leads; the chrome is neutral and edge-drawn.
One accent (teal `#00bfc4`), reserved for primary action, selection, and current position.
Depth comes from borders. A shadow appears only on a layer floating over content it doesn't belong to.
44px targets, a filled accent, and a 0.97 press scale.
Inherits the host theme; light and dark are first-class.
No state rests on color alone.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only hue that acts. Status colors report state and never decorate, and no second brand hue exists.

rules.name: The Mixed, Not Stated Rule
rules.body: Derived levels (`ink-secondary`, `ink-disabled`, `accent-soft`, hover and disabled fills) are `color-mix()` against the panel, and they are redeclared in the dark block so they resolve against the dark panel.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: Copy over a product cutout takes the tile's ink. Copy over a camera frame takes the scene ink, whatever the theme.

rules.name: The Four Weights Rule
rules.body: 400 body, 500 label, 600 emphasis, 700 heading. No other weight appears.

rules.name: The Four Levels Rule
rules.body: Text uses exactly four levels: ink, supporting, muted, disabled. Never invent a fifth gray.

rules.name: The Depth Is Edges Rule
rules.body: A border carries structure; only a floating layer carries a shadow. A new shadow needs a stated reason in the sheet.

rules.name: The Radius Is a Token Rule
rules.body: No rule states a radius as a literal; every radius is one of `rounded.sm`, `control`, `card`, `panel`, or `pill`.

dos: Do take every spacing value from the 4px grid, and every radius, edge, text level, and easing from its token.
Do let device imagery carry the dashboard; keep chrome on `panel`, `line`, and the four text levels.
Do pair every colored state with a non-color signal (dot, word, ring, or stripe).
Do make primary targets 44px and icon actions 40px.
Do redeclare any `color-mix()` token in the dark block when you add one.
Do put a new interactive state in the consolidated state block near the end of `app.css`, in cascade order.
Do use `tile-scene-ink` for copy over a camera frame in both themes.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue. The live preview's red play hover (`#e53935`) and its red-tinted current-device highlight are known drift to bring back to teal.
Don't write literal radii or undefined variables. The wizard map and wizard card use `12px`, `6px`, `14px`, and `var(--border, rgb(128 128 128 / 30%))`, and should use `rounded.*` and `line`.
Don't add a shadow to a resting surface; use an edge.
Don't add a fifth text gray or a weight outside 400/500/600/700.
Don't set a body background. The host page shows through.
Don't contain or desaturate a camera frame the way a product cutout is treated.
